chain_words.nuance: showing good judgement in practical matters
quick to understand and solve problems
having a strong capacity to learn and reason
exceptionally bright and impressive in ability
having a natural talent far above the ordinary

explanation: These words all describe mental ability, from practical good judgement to a natural talent far above the ordinary.

usage_notes.difference: 'Clever' stresses quick thinking and cunning in solving problems; 'intelligent' stresses a broader capacity to learn, understand, and reason.
